usedFor: Stripe sends events like “When a charge succeeds”, and viaSocket utilities hands them on with “Flow in Flow”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a charge succeeds” in Stripe, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A successful charge can start a separate workflow for what comes next.

watchOut: “New Event Occurs” in Stripe is polling, so a flow started from it runs after a short delay.
